name: Enishi Catering
description: Enishi Catering — a block theme for a Harbourside kitchen that caters offices and family celebrations. The home page opens on a full-bleed film-grain photograph of staff setting a long banquet table, with a centred EB Garamond title, an outlined translucent pill and an info bar on the photo; it continues with the engagement as five hairline STEP boxes in a zig-zag row joined by diagonal lines, vertical-caps course rows with wide 2.31:1 photographs, a tasting split, a full-width price list, a night-of-service band, circular portraits and stories. EB Garamond for headings, Karla for reading. WCAG AA colours; the photograph drifts slowly and sections reveal quietly; reduced motion shows the final state.
